title: plagiobothrys diffusus
intro: Plagiobothrys diffusus, commonly known as small fleabane, is a plant species in the borage family. The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential health benefits such as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and fighting infections. It has been reported to have therapeutic actions, including sedative, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which may contribute to its use in treating anxiety, muscle spasms, and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Plagiobothrys diffusus include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
